decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
fact: The front wing/nose assembly, rear wing gurney and setup of the suspension has been changed while under Parc Ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: Williams Racing changed the front wing/nose assembly and rear wing gurney of Car 2 under Parc Ferme without the approval of the Technical Delegate, this not being in accordance with Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. Also changes have been made to the set-up of the suspension, which is a breach of Article 40.9 and Car 2 is required to start the race from Pit Lane.
rules_referenced: Article 40.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
Article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 2 Changes Made During Parc Ferme
